# Synthetic Returns Policy (fixture)

## RP-2.1 Return window
Items delivered within 30 days may be returned for a refund unless sold as final sale.

## RP-2.2 Final sale
Final-sale items cannot be refunded.

## RP-4.1 Value ceiling
Refunds above EUR 250 need a returns supervisor review before any decision.

## RP-3 Fault claims

RP-3.1 **Fault reasons** are defective, arrived_damaged and not_as_described.

RP-3.2 **Evidence.** A defective or arrived_damaged claim needs at least one
photo of the fault before a refund can be recommended.
